title: Docs: What’s new in BC 27 for developers
summary: Business Central 27 (released October 1, 2025) introduces new AL methods, properties, and features for developers, including automation APIs for feature management, enhanced text/record operations, smarter pipelines with directory configuration, improved Copilot integration, and updated compiler rules with stricter error handling.
key_points: New AL methods for GUID creation, truncate operations, text manipulation, and record field access by name
Enhanced properties including MaskType for sensitive data masking, TestType for test organization, and new AllowInCustomizations values for field editability
Smarter pipelines feature with directory.app.props.json for reusable configuration and ALTool compile command support
Changed Date method behavior on blank query columns and stricter AL compiler rules with new error codes
Summary system part customization for Copilot and support for Document ExtendedDataType on media fields
features: Summary system part for Copilot customization

quotes.text: The directory.app.props.json file defines reusable variables and app.json properties for one or more AL apps in a folder.
quotes.why_it_matters: This feature enables developers to manage consistent configuration across multiple AL applications efficiently.
